heroHeadline: Egypt Issues Red-Line Warning Over Gaza Escalation; EGX30 Up 26.4% YTD; Eid Al-Adha National Holiday
heroSubtitle: Egypt escalated its Gaza mediation role on May 30, warning Israel that territorial expansion 'fundamentally violates' the October 2025 ceasefire framework — inviting Hamas chief negotiator Khalil al-Hayya for emergency talks and urging Washington to restrain Netanyahu, while reiterating that mass displacement of Gazans into Sinai remains a firm Egyptian red line. Domestically, Egypt observed Eid Al-Adha (May 27-29) with President Sisi leading prayers at the New Administrative Capital alongside Grand Imam of Al-Azhar Sheikh El-Tayeb. On the economic front, the EGX30 benchmark index closed +26.4% year-to-date on May 24, with strong foreign buying, while the IMF 7th review mission remains in Cairo targeting ~$1.6 billion in new financing.
footerNote: Data sourced from Egyptian official records, UNESCO, academic Egyptology research (Shaw, Lehner, Hawass), major international outlets, IMF, Human Rights Watch, and institutional analyses.
